title: MOONLIGHTTOPIA
description: Moonlighttopia is a cosmic adventure featuring new dimensions, rich exploration, and a Pokémon-inspired quest. Join and begin your journey and forge your path in a new universe!
body:
⏾⋆.˚ Moonlighttopia

A Cobblemon-centered modpack created specifically for our community’s modded server, using curated mods from Modrinth.
Moonlighttopia is a carefully curated modpack designed for our server, combining community-favorite mods from Modrinth to create a smooth and welcoming Cobblemon adventure. Every mod included was chosen to support the kind of environment we wanted: friendly, creative, cozy, and accessible to anyone who wants to join and enjoy.

☾⭒.˚ Features

World Exploration
- Expanded world generation with new biomes, unique terrain, and beautiful landscapes
- Immersive environments that feel alive and fun to wander through
-  Stays close to vanilla for performance and familiarity

Enhanced Cobblemon Experience
- Smoother catching, battling, and exploring
- Add-on mods that enhance Cobblemon without changing its vanilla gameplay feel
- Balanced progression for both solo and group play

Building & Decoration Tools
- Additional decorative blocks for personalizing bases
- Building utilities that make creating easier and more fun
- Great for towns, themed builds, or shared community areas

Multiplayer-Friendly
- Designed for servers with a community-focused vibe
- Perfect for groups who enjoy chill adventures, cooperative building, or exploring together

Beginner-Friendly & Balanced
- Accessible for new players, yet fun for collectors, battlers, explorers, and builders
- Quality-of-life improvements to make gameplay smoother while keeping everything familiar



⏾⋆.˚ Moonlighttopia is more than just a modded Minecraft world — it’s a community built on kindness, comfort, and inclusivity. Our server is an LGBTQ+-friendly safe space where everyone is welcome, supported, and free to be themselves.
Whether you’re here to explore, build a cozy base, collect Cobblemon, or just hang out with friends, our community is built for the girls, gays, theys, and anyone who loves a warm and respectful place to play.


We focus on:
- 🌈 A safe, inclusive environment for LGBTQ+ players
- ✨ Respectful, friendly vibes
- 🫶 Zero tolerance for harassment or discrimination
- 🌙 Chill, community-driven gameplay


If you're looking for a welcoming server where you can relax, be yourself, and enjoy a comfy Cobblemon adventure with good people — Moonlighttopia is the perfect place.
